The current onboarding flow loses about a third of new users before they finish setup. Most of them drop off at the permissions screen, where we ask for microphone and accessibility access at the same time. Users told us it feels like too much at once. We propose splitting the permissions into two steps. The microphone request would come first, right after the welcome screen. Accessibility access would only be requested the first time the user tries to type into another app. For the rollout, we will ship the change to ten percent of new users next week. If the completion rate improves, we will roll it out to everyone by the end of the month.
